snippet.title: Traffic Panic London - Universal - HD Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Traffic Panic London by Neon Play

Will you control Traffic or cause Panic?! The most chaotic traffic management game on the App Store comes to London! 

Join over 4 MILLION fans who have played the Traffic Panic series! 

Tap to change the lights and get points for safely crossing the traffic. If you cause an accident prepare for more points and an explosive cinematic visual feast! 

Explode Nelsons Column, collapse the London Wheel or blow up Battersea! Plus many more unique cinematic moments. 

Control the traffic lights across London in the Classic, Historic and Tourist stages. Plus earn interactive new vehicles, such as the Hippie Van, Car Transporter and Pizza Delivery Guy! 

Control the traffic or cause total panic, it's up to you...

iTunes Store Page:

http://itunes.apple.com/nz/app/traffic-panic-london/id524086769?mt=8

Homepage:

http://www.neonplay.com/
